summary: Recent discussions in the Iceberg community have focused on various enhancements, including the integration with Spark and the introduction of new features in Iceberg versions 1.11.1, 1.12.0, and 1.13.0. Key topics include handling statistics files, spatial data management, and proposals for metadata improvements.
highlights: Handling of existing statistics files in snapshots
File-Level Access Delegation in the Iceberg REST Catalog Spec
